name: Nexus One

images.credit: Zach Vega, CC BY-SA 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Network.Technology: GSM/EDGE 850/900/1800/1900 MHz , UMTS 850/1900/2100 MHz , or UMTS 900/1700/2100 MHz , HSDPA 7.2 Mbit/s , HSUPA 2 Mbit/s , GPRS Class 10

Body.Dimensions: 119 mm H , 59.8 mm W , 11.5 mm D

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android 2.1 "Eclair", Last: Android 2.3.6 "Gingerbread", Unofficial: Android 3.0 "Honeycomb"

Memory.Card slot: microSDHC 4 GB Included (supports up to 32 GB)

Display.Display: At launch: AMOLED , Later: Super LCD , 3.7 in diagonal PenTile , 480×800 px 254 ppi , (0.38 Megapixels) , 3:5 aspect ratio WVGA , 24-bit color , 100,000:1 contrast ratio , 1 ms response rate

Cameras.Rear camera: 5.0-megapixel with 2X digital zoom, 2592×1944 max., Autofocus , LED flash , 720×480 video at 20 FPS or higher

Connectivity.Connectivity: 3.5 mm TRRS , Bluetooth v2.1 + EDR with A2DP , micro USB 2.0 , Wi-Fi IEEE 802.11b/g/n
